title: Treasure Island
hook: 海盗鹦鹉带来一张藏宝图！Dora 和 Boots 要找到蓝钥匙，去宝藏岛挖出宝箱。

cells.en: “I spy a pirate parrot!” He flies in with a treasure chest.
cells.cn: “我发现了一只海盗鹦鹉！”他带着宝箱飞了进来。

cells.en: “We don't know where the treasure chest is,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“我们不知道宝箱在哪里。”

cells.en: The Map says: “Tree, Lake, Treasure Island.” Off they go!
cells.cn: 地图说：“大树、湖、宝藏岛。”出发！

cells.en: “We found the blue key!” Dora and Boots hold it up high.
cells.cn: “我们找到蓝钥匙啦！”Dora 和 Boots 把它高高举起。

cells.en: A big iguana says “grande, grande!” Grande means very big.
cells.cn: 一只大鬣蜥说“grande, grande！”grande 就是“很大”的意思。

cells.en: “Ah! The blue key!” Swiper wants to swipe it from them.
“You tell me if you see an ‘X’,” says Dora on the sand.
cells.cn: Dora 在沙滩上说：“看到‘X’就告诉我。”

cells.en: “First put your hands out in front of you.” They dig and dig.
cells.cn: “先把双手伸到前面。”他们挖呀挖呀挖。

cells.en: “The treasure chest!” At last they open it on Treasure Island.
cells.cn: “宝箱！”他们终于在宝藏岛上打开了它。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Treasure Island”.
ending: In the end, Dora and Boots open the treasure chest. My favorite part is ______.
